name: Burpee
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your arms by your sides.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor just in front of your feet.
Jump or step your feet back so you are in a push-up position with your body in a straight line.
Optionally lower your chest to the floor and press back up.
Jump or step your feet back towards your hands, landing in a squat.
Stand up and jump, reaching your arms overhead. Land softly and go straight into the next rep.

name: Jumping Jacks
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together and your arms by your sides.
Jump your feet out to slightly wider than your shoulders while raising your arms out to the sides and overhead.
Jump your feet back together while bringing your arms back down.
Keep a steady rhythm and land softly on the balls of your feet. Step instead of jumping for a low-impact version.

name: Wall Sit
instructions: Stand with your back flat against a wall and your feet about shoulder-width apart, a little in front of you.
Slide down the wall until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees, as if sitting on a chair. Go less deep if that is more comfortable.
Keep your knees above your ankles and your back against the wall.
Hold for the target time, breathing steadily, then slide back up.

name: Bird Dog
instructions: Start on your hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Brace your stomach as if about to be poked, keeping your back flat.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are in line with your body. Keep your hips level.
Pause for a moment, return to the start, and repeat on the other side. Each side counts as one rep.
